name: Yau Tsi-chi
source:
A university student at EdUHK.
He participated in the Umbrella Revolution with Lam Lam and met Johnny in a free tutorial at the occupied Central.
He has a calm personality and is majoring in psychology at the university.
He is also a good singer, and has a regular fan base from his weekly street live performances in a park on Dundas Street with a guitar in his hand, but the ghosts of those fans are trying to kill him.
He has a liking for Lam Lam.
